title: LearnOps Moodle web-services allow-list (B4, v1)
description: The Moodle web-services functions LearnOps may call (PRD B4), with the parameters LearnOps sends and, only where a function's name differs on a Moodle version, the replacement name. The rules (service account, token, draft rule, capabilities, lab checks) are in contracts/moodle-ws.v1.md, which is the normative text. libs/moodle_ws builds its allow-list from the example file of this schema, so contract and code cannot drift apart (guide's decision on Q1, PR #27).
$comment: No verification state is stored here: results of the lab checks go to docs/decisions/ (guide's decision on Q1), so any property name containing 'verif' is refused. Unknown fields are otherwise allowed, as in every contract (PRD B.0, EXT-02). NOT expressible here, so checked by libs/contracts/tests/test_moodle_ws_v1.py: function names are unique and equal the PRD B4 list; every listed parameter is named in the PRD; a replacement name also appears in the PRD B4 text (the guide's rule: change the PRD in the same pull request as the replacement).

function_name.description: A Moodle web-services function name, for example core_course_get_contents.

purpose.description: The Purpose cell of the PRD B4 table.

parameters.description: Names of the parameters LearnOps sends that the PRD names. An empty list means 'not yet determined' (lab check 1 in moodle-ws.v1.md), never 'no parameters'. Names are added only after they are checked on both lab sites.

replacements.description: Only where the function's name differs on a Moodle version. Absent when the name is the same on 4.5 and 5.3.
